s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute respiratory symptoms with obstructing tracheal mass
salient_findings: Polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Mass causing obstruction of main bronchi
key_facts: 48-year-old white man
Lifelong non-smoker
Remote bronchoscopic resection of tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier
Three-month history of mild hemoptysis and cough
Non-tender subcutaneous mass on left forearm
Normal vital signs
Oxygen saturation of 94% on room air
Normal laboratory studies
Chest CT scan showed polypoid lesion in precarinal tracheal region
Flexible bronchoscopy revealed mass arising from anterior tracheal wall
Mass caused 80% obstruction of right main bronchus and 70% obstruction of left main bronchus
Lesion resected bronchoscopically with electrocautery

differentials: Tracheal glomus tumor with metastasis to soft tissue
Ectomesenchymal chondromyxoid tumor of the trachea
per_call: Tracheal glomus tumor with metastasis to soft tissue
Ectomesenchymal chondromyxoid tumor of the trachea

shortlist.label: Tracheal carcinoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: History of remote bronchoscopic resection of tracheal carcinoid and current presentation with obstructing tracheal mass

shortlist.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute respiratory symptoms with obstructing tracheal mass, a common presentation for this tumor type

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Obstructing tracheal mass and history of hemoptysis, although patient is a non-smoker

shortlist.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tracheal mass with obstructive symptoms, a possible presentation for this salivary gland-type tumor

shortlist.label: Neuroendocrine carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similarities with tracheal carcinoid tumor and potential for aggressive behavior

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of remote bronchoscopic resection of a tracheal carcinoid 17 years earlier and the current lesion's histology, with large nests of eosinophilic cells within a collagenous and myxoid matrix, is consistent with a carcinoid tumor.

rejected.label: Adenoid cystic carcinoma
rejected.why: No specific histological features mentioned that are typical of adenoid cystic carcinoma

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The histological description does not match squamous cell carcinoma, which typically shows squamous differentiation

rejected.label: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
rejected.why: The histological features do not suggest mucoepidermoid carcinoma, which typically contains mucinous and epidermoid components

rejected.label: Neuroendocrine carcinoma
rejected.why: While carcinoid tumors are neuroendocrine in nature, the term 'neuroendocrine carcinoma' is broader and the specific diagnosis of carcinoid tumor is more precise given the patient's history and histological findings
